english_draft: Samsung Electronics reported Q1 2026 revenue of KRW 133.9 trillion and operating profit of KRW 57.2 trillion, both all-time quarterly highs, according to its April 30, 2026 release. The DS Division posted KRW 81.7 trillion revenue and KRW 53.7 trillion operating profit. Memory set records on AI demand and higher ASP. For Q2 2026, Memory expects strong demand from AI infrastructure expansion and plans first HBM4E samples. Foundry plans full utilization of advanced-node lines and earnings improvement from increased HBM4 base-die supply. System LSI targets higher SoC and sensor sales. MX expects QoQ revenue decline but YoY growth. SDC will focus on the premium segment. VD targets sporting-event-related demand. DA expects revenue growth from a new premium lineup and air-conditioner recovery. Harman expects earnings growth from higher auto supply. Core questions: Can Memory ASP and volume stay at record levels? Can Foundry reach full utilization and improve earnings? How much will MX profitability decline in a seasonally weaker quarter? Positive deviations would include stronger memory pricing, earlier HBM4E ramp, and better MX YoY growth. Negative deviations would include sharper MX QoQ decline, weak SDC small/medium demand, and tariff/cost pressure in DA. Verification points: DS revenue and operating profit; Memory record level; Foundry utilization wording; MX revenue direction and margin; SDC segment mix; Harman qualitative guidance.
reader_questions: 如果第二季度记忆体ASP未能延续环比上升，DS收入是否会明显低于一季度81.7万亿韩元？
MX收入环比下降的幅度若大于公司常规季节性降幅，其营业利润率能否仍维持在个位数？
如果Foundry未能在6月底前达到先进制程产线满载，DS的整体营业利润是否仍可依靠Memory维持高位？
fact_checks: 核对日期与季度：来源为2026年4月30日发布的“Samsung Electronics Announces First Quarter 2026 Results”，覆盖截至2026年3月31日的2026Q1；本前瞻针对截至2026年6月30日的2026Q2。
核对Q1数字：合并收入133.9万亿韩元、营业利润57.2万亿韩元；DS收入81.7万亿韩元、营业利润53.7万亿韩元；MX与Networks收入38.1万亿韩元、营业利润2.8万亿韩元；VD与DA合计收入14.3万亿韩元、营业利润0.2万亿韩元；SDC收入6.7万亿韩元、营业利润0.4万亿韩元。与来源一致。
核对业务事项：HBM4与SOCAMM2首次向NVIDIA Vera Rubin平台量产销售、2026Q2首次交付HBM4E样品、Foundry先进制程产线满载目标、MX收入环比下降但同比成长、Harman靠汽车供应增加改善盈利等，均为公司业绩公告中的表述，非本稿推测。
核对口径：收入与营业利润均为公司合并口径；分部收入之和大于合并收入源于内部抵消等因素；Harman未披露Q1利润金额。
核对共识：所附来源未提供市场共识或量化区间，正文不引用外部共识、股价或未披露数字。
